research.recommended_topic: Last-Minute FY25 Tax-Saving & Money Mistakes Salaried Professionals Must Avoid Before March 31
research.audience_problem: Salaried Indian millennials and Gen Z professionals often rush into low-yield, illiquid financial products in late March purely to claim Section 80C/80D tax deductions, destroying long-term wealth compounding.
research.why_now: The March 31 financial year deadline creates a time-sensitive urgency spike in search and social conversations around tax saving, Form 16, and salary investment proof submissions.
research.hook: Stop locking your money in 5% returns just to save tax before March 31st! Avoid these 3 costly mistakes.
supporting_points: Compare New vs. Old Tax Regime dynamically to ensure tax deductions actually benefit your specific income slab.
Prioritize high-efficiency instruments like ELSS mutual funds (3-year lock-in, equity exposure) over long-term low-yield endowment plans.
Leverage health insurance (Section 80D) and NPS (Section 80CCD(1B)) for extra tax deductions beyond the standard 80C limit.
Actionable step-by-step checklist to submit proof documents on HR payroll portals before deadline cutoff.
trend_signals: Spike in Google India & Instagram search queries for 'Tax Saving ELSS', 'Old vs New Tax Regime', and 'Section 80C investments'
High engagement on educational carousel slides and 60-second talking-head Reel breakdowns with downloadable checklist CTAs

carousel_outline: Slide 1 (Hook): Salary credit hone ke baad account empty? 3 Money habits to build in your 20s.
Slide 2: Mistake #1 - Keeping everything in a basic savings account. Smart Move: Enable auto-sweep or move emergency funds to liquid funds for better returns.
Slide 3: Mistake #2 - Buying trend items on 'No-Cost EMI' without a budget. Smart Move: Follow the 24-hour rule before pressing 'Buy Now'.
Slide 4: Mistake #3 - Waiting to 'save bigger amounts' before investing. Smart Move: Start an automated SIP with as little as ₹500 on salary day.
Slide 5 (Summary): Future self hidden flex: Financial peace of mind. Save this checklist for your next payday!
